jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data Analytics), AI & Data Platforms (AiDP)
jobs.description:
Apple's AI \& Data Platform (AiDP) Data Services organization is seeking a motivated Software Engineer, Data Analytics focused on providing data analytics and search services. Engineers on this team build data processing platforms and develop required tooling for Apple's most critical internet services at massive scale. In AiDP, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users.  

  

AI \& Data Platforms (AiDP) is IS\&T's engine for AI\-powered innovation. The team brings together data, application development, and machine learning \- including generative AI \- along with data services and customer success functions, to help IS\&T build solutions more efficiently and streamline the adoption and embedding of generative AI across Apple.  

  

**Description**  

  

The AiDP Data Services Analytics team builds data analytics and search capabilities \- provisioning, backup/restore, observability, and self\-service \- spanning OpenSearch, ClickHouse, SingleStore, Couchbase, Apache Doris, Apache Milvus, etc. This role involves supporting data processing and migration efforts across hybrid\-cloud environments (On\-Prem AWS AliCloud) following established Runbooks and adhering to local data residency and regulatory requirements (e.g., China's Cybersecurity Law and PIPL). This role requires good communication and collaboration with infrastructure teams and colleagues across a distributed team.","responsibilities":"Build and run data processing platforms with required monitoring, alerting, and incident management, achieving growing independence  

  

Build working knowledge of data analytics and search concepts (distributed data processing, fast querying, consistency models) across OpenSearch, ClickHouse, Couchbase, Doris, Milvus, etc.  

  

Support performance engineering efforts (profiling, tuning) under guidance from senior team members  

  

Assist with service management across bare metal, virtualized (EC2, AliCloud ECS), and containerized (K8s) style platforms  

  

Execute and support data migration tasks across hybrid clouds, including validation and rollback support  

  

Build understanding of operating systems and datacenter architecture concepts relevant to transactional workloads  

  

Produce and maintain clear documentation \- Runbooks, architecture diagrams, and migration playbook updates  

  

Support compliance with local data residency and regulatory requirements applicable to China\-based infrastructure  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Some operational experience with stateful services on Kubernetes  

  

Exposure to database\-as\-a\-service control planes, provisioning APIs, or self\-service tooling  

  

Experience assisting with cross\-cloud / hybrid\-cloud data migrations for transactional systems  

  

Familiarity with observability concepts (SLIs/SLOs), backup, and DR practices for OLTP/distributed\-SQL engines  

  

Solid troubleshooting skills, a resourceful first\-principles approach to problem solving, and good technical writing habits  

  

Contributions to open\-source database projects or internal data\-platform tooling  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

3\+ years experience in data analytics and/or data search space  

  

Experience and knowledge of Java or Python programming languages  

  

Hands\-on production experience with at least one of the following technologies: Solar, Elastic Search, Iceberg, ClickHouse, Doris and/or Couchbase  

  

Exposure to running infrastructure with reliance on automation tooling, across Datacenter and Cloud architectures (including Alibaba Cloud and/or AWS)  

  

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related work experience  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Systems/Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
Systems/Software Engineer III  



This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.**Who We Are:**


Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

  



Role Overview


We are looking for a System Test Automation Engineer who is a software engineer at heart, with strong systems knowledge, sharp analytical thinking, and a passion for building scalable, automated quality frameworks.


This role focuses on validating complex, distributed software systems through automation, observability, and system‑level testing rather than manual or UI‑centric testing. You will analyze system behavior, reason about failure modes, and derive clear conclusions even when working with incomplete, ambiguous, or noisy data.


You will work closely with development, architecture, and platform teams to embed quality early in the lifecycle, design robust test frameworks, apply data‑driven quality insights, and prevent defects from reaching customers.


Key Responsibilities


Test Automation \& Frameworks

* Design, develop, and maintain system‑level test automation frameworks for complex software platforms.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation.
* Own test infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling — not just individual test cases.


System‑Level Validation

* Build and execute regression, scale, stress, soak, and fault‑injection tests.
* Validate system behavior under real‑world conditions including high load, failures, and degraded states.
* Identify issues related to timing, concurrency, memory leaks, performance, and resource exhaustion.


Observability, Analysis \& Debugging

* Leverage and enhance observability signals (logs, metrics, traces, counters).
* Apply analytical and logical reasoning to break down complex behaviors and isolate root causes.
* Use data‑driven analysis to detect regressions, identify trends, and surface systemic quality risks.
* Diagnose failures by clearly distinguishing test issues vs product defects.
* Work with developers to add testability hooks, diagnostics, and observability into the product.


Early Quality Engagement

* Participate in design and architecture reviews with a strong testability and quality mindset.
* Influence design choices to enable deterministic, scalable, and measurable testing.
* Shift defect detection earlier in the development lifecycle through proactive quality engineering.


Collaboration \& Ownership

* Partner closely with development, release, and operations teams.
* Influence engineering decisions using clear data, analysis, and technical communication.
* Take end‑to‑end ownership of system quality for assigned features or platforms.


Required Qualifications

**Education and Experienced Required:**

* Typically 8\-10 years of work experience in Test Engineering
* Bachelor's degree

**Technical Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or C\+\+ (at least one at production depth).
* Proven experience building automation frameworks, not just test scripts.
* Solid understanding of Linux/UNIX fundamentals (processes, memory, networking).
* Familiarity with CI/CD systems and version control (Git‑based workflows).
* Experience testing complex, multi‑component, distributed systems.


Analytical, Testing \& Systems Knowledge

* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with the ability to break down complex system behaviors and derive clear conclusions from incomplete or ambiguous data.
* Ability to apply data‑driven analysis to identify trends, detect regressions, prioritize quality risks, and influence engineering decisions.
* Deep understanding of system‑level testing concepts, including:
* Regression and longevity testing
* Fault injection and recovery
* Scale and performance testing
* Strong debugging skills across software layers.


We are not looking for traditional manual QA profiles.


This role requires strong software engineering depth combined with analytical rigor.

**GenAI‑Assisted Engineering Practices**

* Experience using GenAI‑assisted development tools (e.g., VS Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) to improve productivity in coding, test development, analysis, and debugging workflows.
* Ability to effectively leverage GenAI for:
* Rapid prototyping of test frameworks and utilities
* Log analysis, test failure triage, and root‑cause exploration
* Improving code quality, readability, and maintainability
* Strong judgment in using GenAI tools as engineering accelerators, with a clear understanding of their limitations, validation needs, and appropriate use in production‑quality workflows.


We value engineers who combine strong fundamentals with modern AI‑assisted tooling — using GenAI to improve speed and quality without compromising rigor, correctness, or system understanding.

**Preferred Skills**

* Networking fundamentals (Firewall,L2/L3, TCP/IP, routing, congestion behavior).
* Experience with embedded systems, network operating systems, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with sanitizers, memory leak and corruption detection and diagnostic tools (ASAN, LSAN, TSAN, Valgrind, perf).
* Experience with observability stacks and telemetry systems.
* Prior SDET or platform quality engineering experience in large‑scale environments.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description:
OneTrack is a profitable, growth\-stage technology company redefining manufacturing and logistics with physical AI. OneTrack operates as the intelligence layer for physical operations. We serve the world's largest brands and logistics companies by deploying camera sensors and other data\-capture devices alongside our mission control platform and AI agents. Today, OneTrack runs in hundreds of warehouses and factories across North America with companies like Ashley Furniture, Mars Snacking, The Wonderful Company, Ryder, and Church \& Dwight.

**About the Position**


We're hiring a full\-stack engineer to join our team and work on AiOn, our agentic AI platform. The scope covers the whole product: the UI operators use, the agent and prompt design behind it, the Python services, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. From floor\-level to supervisors to C\-suite executives at Fortune 500s, our agentic AI platform connects the systems of record with places of action in some of the most demanding operational environments.


AiOn is already live in hundreds of warehouses and factories, so the work splits roughly evenly between new features and making what exists faster, more reliable, and more extensible. We integrate frontier models from multiple providers rather than train our own, so the engineering is in the product around them. We work from first principles and ship the simplest thing that solves the problem, then refine it.

**Responsibilities**

* Ship and evolve full\-stack features from UI through API to agent logic
* Build and extend our agent framework: tool and function calling, multi\-step reasoning, and context management
* Build structured tool and data access over operational data with schema grounding, validation, and safe execution, and integrate the external systems agents act on
* Build evaluation and observability for quality, latency, safety, cost, and product outcomes such as task completion
* Improve reliability, robustness, and latency across a distributed, event\-driven backend, and re\-architect early implementations as the platform matures
* Maintain guardrails: least\-privilege tool design, safe execution boundaries, fallbacks, and kill switches
* Work anywhere in the stack the problem requires: React and TypeScript UI, an Electron desktop app, streaming interfaces that stay usable while output is still partial, and Python services on AWS built around async and event\-driven patterns

 **Requirements**  

* 5\+ years building production full\-stack or backend software, or a track record demonstrating equivalent depth
* Recent hands\-on experience integrating LLMs into user\-facing production applications
* Shipped a user\-facing agentic or LLM\-powered feature and owned it across the full stack
* Built evaluation harnesses for non\-deterministic systems
* Track record of improving reliability, performance, and maintainability of production systems
* Strong Python and TypeScript/React, both used daily
* Built agent orchestration, or deep experience with a framework and its tradeoffs
* REST API and service design, plus async and event\-driven patterns (queues, streaming, WebSockets)
* Production experience deploying and running services on AWS
* Product judgment for user\-facing AI, including iterating from operator feedback and handling uncertain output well
* Fluent with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar)


Preferred Qualifications* Tool and system integration for agents (e.g. MCP)
* Sandboxing and safe execution of untrusted code
* LLMOps or AgentOps tooling and CI/CD for AI systems
* Streaming and WebSocket patterns for real\-time or long\-running tasks
* Data\-ingestion pipelines and multi\-store data consistency
* Logistics, supply chain, or physical\-operations domain experience


What This Role Is Not* Not a prompt\-only role wrapping a model API, and not demo\-ware. This runs in production for enterprise customers.
* Not frontend\-only or backend\-only. You own the full path.
* Not greenfield\-only. Much of the impact is hardening, optimizing, and re\-architecting a platform already in production.

  

**Benefits**  

Work with some of the most ambitious and intense people you can be around. Predominantly located in New York and Chicago, but remain open to remote employees. Compensation is commensurate with experience and is estimated to range from $160,000 to $250,000\. The role is eligible for a performance\-based cash bonus and equity awards.
